route_role: Exact retained undated editorial current reference routes, not dated or mean model axes, source-digitized curves, bathymetric contours or physical polygons. Preserve all original vertices and route owner. No source geometry is expanded or changed in response to the sampled velocities.
longitude_policy: Select nearest source longitude by circular angular distance, preserving first source index in a tie. Keep native0–360 longitude and global source index alongside normalized[-180,180) sampled longitude. A cyclic window whose naive bounding slab spans too much of the grid must fail the pre-read cell budget, never request a global patch.
horizontal_selection: WGS84 neighboring reference vertices define a one-sided endpoint/interior tangent. Sample the five fixed normals at nearest source nodes. Frozen peak-core selector chooses greatest positive downstream component above the per-object primary threshold within0–200m; first offset order breaks ties. Keep outer-offset maxima as axis unresolved; no window expansion or alternate-node contour selection.
vertical_operator: Project east/north velocity onto one declared reference tangent bearing held fixed through all40standard depths0–5000m. Retain signed deep counterflow. Frozen connected-layer operator diagnoses both boundaries connected to the qualifying0–200m core and first adjacent crossings. Missing/dry/domain-edge support remains censored;0m is an upper layer boundary only with contiguous native surface support. No seabed or terminal-grid substitution.
threshold_comparison: All5/10/20cm/s diagnoses stay at the primary-selected node and retain their own qualifying cores. Differences are operator sensitivity, not confidence bounds or physical errors. The poleward word in the frozen helper no-core status is explicitly relabelled downstream for equatorward branches while retaining the original status separately.
transport_budget: Only coordinates read first; at most20000cell-pairs per velocity slab and250000 for the entire three-current run. Precheck each patch at16decodedbytes per east/north pair;7MB decoded total cap. Retain source hyperslab indices and canonical decoded-profile hashes. NetCDF wire bytes and wire-byte SHA are not instrumented.
